DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はどうされましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の自転車の鍵をなくしました。鍵屋さんから、防犯登録の控えがあるか聞かれました。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鍵の紛失と防犯登録控えを求められた事情を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've lost the key to my bicycle. The locksmith asked whether I have my bicycle security registration receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the lost key and that you were asked for your security registration receipt. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その控えはお持ちですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 控えが見つかりません。自転車の車体番号を撮った写真ならあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控えの代わりに車体番号写真を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can't find it. I do have a photo of the bicycle's frame number.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show a photo of the frame number instead of the receipt. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写真を拝見します。購入した店の書類は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let me see the photo. Do you still have paperwork from the shop where you bought it?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: レシートは家にあります。ここで持ち主の確認をしてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入レシートの所在を述べ所有確認を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The purchase receipt is at home. Can you check ownership here?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say where your purchase receipt is and ask about confirming ownership. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できる資料や手続きは担当に相談します。ここで鍵を開ける許可証を発行するわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll consult the person responsible about documents and procedures for verification. We are not issuing a permit to open the lock here.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。自転車は駅前の駐輪場にありますが、移動せず置いておいていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 駐輪場に残す自転車の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. The bicycle is in the parking area in front of the station. May I leave it there without moving it?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to handle the bicycle left in the parking area. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 駐輪場での保管は管理者に聞いてください。こちらはまず登録に関する相談を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask the parking manager about storing it there. Here we'll first hear your inquiry about registration.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、登録の相談をお願いします。駐輪場にも事情を伝え、レシートを取りに戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 登録相談と駐輪場への連絡を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then please help with the registration inquiry. I'll explain the situation to the bicycle parking staff too, and go home to get the purchase receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to consult about registration and contact the bicycle parking staff. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。お帰りの際はお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: バッグをお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通勤用です。雨の日に、傘を持ったまま定期入れを出しやすい物が欲しいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 傘を持った通勤時の取り出しやすさを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's for commuting. On rainy days, I want one that makes it easy to take out my commuter pass holder while holding an umbrella.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the need for easy access while commuting with an umbrella. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外ポケット付きのこちらはいかがですか。肩に掛けてお試しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: How about this one with an outer pocket? Please try it on your shoulder.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 掛けてみます。ポケットのボタンは片手だと少し固いですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 肩掛け試用でボタンの固さを指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll try it. The pocket button is a little stiff to undo with one hand.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Try the bag on your shoulder and point out the stiff button. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらはファスナーです。引き手が大きいのでつまみやすいと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This one has a zipper. The pull is large, so I think it's easy to grasp.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらなら開けられます。中の書類が濡れにくいように、上も閉まりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ファスナー操作を試し上部の閉じ方を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can open this one. Does the top also close so the documents inside are less likely to get wet?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Try the zipper and ask how the top closes. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 上にもファスナーがあります。ただし完全防水ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: There's a zipper at the top too. However, it's not completely waterproof.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 書類は別の袋に入れます。肩ひもを少し短くできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 書類の対策を示しひもの調整を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll put the documents in a separate bag. Can you shorten the shoulder strap a little?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain your plan to protect the documents and ask for the strap to be adjusted. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、ここで長さを変えられます。今の長さで鏡をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, the length adjusts here. Please look in the mirror with it at this length.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この位置なら取り出しやすいです。ファスナーの方を購入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 調整後の位置を評価し商品を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: It's easy to reach things at this position. I'll buy the one with the zipper.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Evaluate the adjusted position and choose a product. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。こちらでお包みします。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. I'll wrap it here. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 果物をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to look at the fruit?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この桃を一個だけ欲しいです。札の六百円は一個の値段ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: パック価格と一個価格を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like just one of these peaches. Is the six hundred yen on the sign the price for one?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Distinguish the pack price from the price of one piece. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 六百円は二個入りのパックです。ばら売りは一個三百五十円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Six hundred yen is for a pack of two. Individually, they're three hundred fifty yen each.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ばらでお願いします。今日食べたいのですが、柔らかい物を選べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ばら売りを選び食べ頃の桃を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll take one individually. I'd like to eat it today. Could you choose a soft one?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose an individually sold peach and ask for one ready to eat. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日ならこちらが食べ頃です。触らずに私が取りますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: This one is ready to eat today. Please don't touch it; I'll pick it up for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。皮にある小さな茶色い点は傷でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表面の点の状態を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Is the small brown spot on the skin damage?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the condition of the spot on the surface. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表面の点です。こちらの大きなへこみとは違います。気になるようでしたら別の物もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's a spot on the surface. It's different from this large dent. If it bothers you, we have others too.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この点なら気にしません。選んだ一個を、そのまま手で持ち帰れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 選んだ果物の持ち帰り方を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't mind this spot. Can I carry the one we've chosen home just in my hand?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to carry the chosen fruit home. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 薄い紙で包めます。押すと傷むので、底を支えてお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can wrap it in thin paper. Pressure will damage it, so please support the bottom when carrying it.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 紙で包んでください。かばんには入れず、底を持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紙包みと支え方を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please wrap it in paper. I won't put it in my bag; I'll carry it home supporting the bottom.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide on paper wrapping and supporting the fruit. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。ありがとうございました。

DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談予約の受付です。どのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the consultation appointment desk. What would you like to consult about?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 賃貸の退去費用についてです。請求書が届きましたが、見方が分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 退去費用の請求書について相談を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's about charges for moving out of a rental. I've received an invoice but don't understand how to read it.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a consultation about an invoice for move-out charges. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 契約や請求の相談ですね。書類を持参する相談枠をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: A contract and billing inquiry, then. We'll offer an appointment where you bring the documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 平日の昼は仕事です。夕方の枠はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 仕事に合わせ夕方枠を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: I work during the day on weekdays. Are there evening appointments?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about an evening slot to fit your work schedule. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今週は埋まっていますが、来週の木曜十七時なら空きがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: This week is full, but next Thursday at five p.m. is available.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 木曜なら行けます。請求書だけで足りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 木曜枠を選び必要資料を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can come on Thursday. Is the invoice alone enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the Thursday slot and ask what documents are needed. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 契約書や部屋の写真もあればお持ちください。費用の妥当性は相談担当が個別に扱います。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also bring the contract and room photos if you have them. The consultation staff member handles whether charges are appropriate individually.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 契約書はメールで届いています。画面を見せてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電子契約書の提示方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: The contract arrived by email. May I show it on the screen?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to present an electronic contract. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、この相談では画面でも受け付けます。予約のお名前をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, for this consultation we accept it on screen too. May I have the name for the booking?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 田中でお願いします。木曜十七時に、請求書とメール、写真を持って来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 氏名と予約時刻と持参資料を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: Tanaka, please. I'll bring the invoice, email, and photos on Thursday at five p.m.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm your name, appointment time, and documents to bring. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 予約をお取りしました。当日はこの窓口へお越しください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your appointment is booked. Please come to this counter on the day. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 税の書類についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to ask about tax documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 封筒に二種類の紙が入っていました。どちらも支払う紙なのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知と納付用紙の役割を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: There were two kinds of paper in the envelope. Are both of them for making payments?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the roles of the notice and payment slip. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 拝見します。一枚は通知、もう一枚は納付用の用紙ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see. One is a notice and the other is a payment slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 通知に四つの金額が並んでいます。この用紙はその全部をまとめた分ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 用紙が全期間合計か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: The notice lists four amounts. Does this slip cover all of them together?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether the slip covers the total for all periods. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この用紙の対象期間を、下の欄と照らし合わせましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's compare the period this slip covers with the field below.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 下には第一期と書いてあります。残りの用紙がないのですが、後で届くのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 第一期の表示を読み残り用紙の発送を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says first installment below. I don't have the remaining slips. Will they arrive later?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read the first-installment label and ask about mailing the remaining slips. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この封筒だけでは発送状況は分かりません。担当が記録を調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can't tell the mailing status from this envelope alone. The person responsible will check the records.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。通知もここに置いておいた方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 照会中の通知の扱いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Should I leave the notice here too?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what to do with the notice during the inquiry. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当にお渡しする間は二枚ともお預かりします。お名前をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll keep both papers while passing them to the person responsible. Please tell me your name.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 田中です。二枚を一緒に渡します。残りの用紙について担当に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 氏名を述べ二枚を担当へ渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'm Tanaka. I'll hand over the two papers together. I'd like to ask the person responsible about the remaining slips.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give your name and hand both papers to the person responsible. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。担当窓口へご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll guide you to the relevant counter. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you decided on your order?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ごまのアレルギーがあります。このラーメンは上のごまを抜けば食べられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ごまアレルギーと具抜きの可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a sesame allergy. Could I eat this ramen if you remove the sesame on top?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your sesame allergy and ask whether removing the topping would work. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: たれにもごまが入ります。具だけを抜いても避けられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: The sauce contains sesame too. Removing only the topping won't avoid it.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: たれにも入るのですね。ごまを使わない料理はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: たれの含有を理解し別料理を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the sauce contains it too. Do you have dishes that don't use sesame?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand the sesame in the sauce and ask about another dish. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 材料として使わない料理はありますが、同じ調理場で作っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: We have dishes that don't use it as an ingredient, but they're made in the same kitchen.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別の調理器具を使って、ごまが混ざらないようにできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 混入回避の調理対応を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: Can you use separate utensils to prevent sesame getting mixed in?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about cooking arrangements to avoid cross-contact. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 専用の調理場所がないので、混入しないとお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: We don't have a dedicated cooking area, so we can't promise it won't get mixed in.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では今日は食事の注文をやめます。まだ何も作り始めていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 注文を見送り調理開始前か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I won't order a meal today. You haven't started making anything yet, have you?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide not to order and confirm cooking has not begun. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、注文前なので料理は作っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. You haven't ordered yet, so we haven't made any food.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今回は席を空けます。詳しく教えてくださってありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明へ礼を述べ退席する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll leave the seat this time. Thank you for explaining in detail.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Thank them for the explanation and leave your seat. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望に添えず申し訳ありません。どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm sorry we couldn't meet your needs. Please take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。二人で来ていて、私は先に帰ります。自分の分だけ払えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一人先に帰るため別会計を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. There are two of us, but I'm leaving first. May I pay for just my share?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for separate payment because you are leaving before the other person. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 別々の会計ができます。どの料理がお客様の分ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can split the bill. Which dishes are yours?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 焼き魚とウーロン茶です。枝豆は二人で食べたので、私の方に付けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の料理と共有料理の負担を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: The grilled fish and oolong tea. We shared the edamame, so please put that on my bill too.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify your dishes and who will pay for the shared dish. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。あとから追加したおにぎりもありますが、こちらはどうしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: Certainly. There's also the rice ball ordered later. What should we do about that?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: おにぎりは残る人の分です。私の分は合計いくらになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追加料理の負担者を分け合計を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: The rice ball is for the person staying. How much is my total?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish who pays for the additional dish and ask the total. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 千八百円です。残りはもうお一人のお会計にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: One thousand eight hundred yen. We'll put the rest on the other person's bill.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 千八百円をカードで払います。レシートも別に出ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カード払いと個別レシートを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll pay the one thousand eight hundred yen by card. Will I receive a separate receipt too?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to pay by card and receive an individual receipt. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、お客様の三品だけ記載されます。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. It will list only your three items.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それでお願いします。もう一人には、自分の分を払ったと伝えて帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 支払い内容を了解し同行者への伝達を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: That's fine, thank you. I'll tell the other person I've paid my share before I leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Accept the payment details and say you will inform your companion. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you decided on your order?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ステーキのセットをお願いします。肉は切ってから出してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ステーキセットと切り分け提供を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like the steak set. Could you cut the meat before serving it?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Order the steak set and ask for the meat to be served cut up. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食べやすい大きさに切ってお出しできます。焼き方はいかがなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can serve it cut into pieces that are easy to eat. How would you like it cooked?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: よく焼いてください。細かすぎるより、一口大がいいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: よく焼きと一口大を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: Well done, please. I'd prefer bite-sized pieces rather than very small ones.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify well done and bite-sized pieces. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一口大ですね。付け合わせも一緒の皿に載せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: Bite-sized, then. We'll put the side dishes on the same plate too.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 付け合わせの玉ねぎは、肉の下ではなく横に置いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 付け合わせの配置を肉の横に頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: Could you put the onion side dish beside the meat rather than underneath it?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the side dish beside the meat. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、横に置けます。ご飯の量は普通でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, we can put it beside the meat. Is the regular amount of rice all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ご飯は少なめでお願いします。肉の量は普通のままで大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ご飯だけ少なめにし肉量は維持する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: Less rice, please. The regular amount of meat is fine.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for less rice only while keeping the meat portion unchanged. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。肉はよく焼いて一口大、ご飯は少なめですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. The meat well done and bite-sized, with less rice, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、玉ねぎは横に添えてください。それでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 焼き方と切り方と配置を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, and please place the onions at the side. That's what I'd like.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the cooking, cutting, and placement. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。どうぞごゆっくり。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please relax and enjoy your time.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 庭園の案内図がございます。

DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と池の横で待ち合わせですが、雨が強くなりました。屋根のある場所に変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 雨で池の待ち合わせを屋根の下へ変えたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm meeting a friend beside the pond, but the rain has become heavy. I'd like to change to somewhere with a roof.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to move your pond meeting place under a roof because of the rain. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入口近くの休憩所が使えます。池から来る方にも分かりやすい場所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can use the rest area near the entrance. It's easy for someone coming from the pond to find too.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人はもう池にいると思います。休憩所の名前は何と伝えればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 池から来る友人に伝える施設名を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: I think my friend is already at the pond. What should I tell them the rest area is called?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the facility name to tell your friend coming from the pond. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 地図には南休憩所とあります。池の橋から入口へ戻る道沿いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: The map calls it the South Rest Area. It's along the path back to the entrance from the pond bridge.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 南休憩所ですね。荷物があるので、そこに座って待てますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名前を確認し座って待てるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: The South Rest Area, then. I have luggage; can I sit there while waiting?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the name and ask whether you can sit and wait. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、ベンチがあります。ただ、屋内の飲食店ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, there are benches. However, it isn't an indoor café or restaurant.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 飲み物は買わずに待ちます。閉まる時間は近いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 利用方法と残り時間を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait without buying a drink. Is it nearly closing time?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check how to use it and the time remaining. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 庭園の閉園まで使えます。今日はまだ一時間あります。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can use it until the garden closes. There's still one hour today.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人に南休憩所へ変更と連絡します。そこで荷物を置いて待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人への変更連絡と待機場所を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell my friend we've changed to the South Rest Area. I'll put my luggage down and wait there.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to tell your friend about the change and establish the waiting place. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、雨で滑りやすいのでお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. The rain makes it slippery, so please take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内のご案内はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like information about the zoo?

DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ペンギンの食事を見たいです。案内板には午後とありますが、何時ごろですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ペンギンの食事開始時刻を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to see the penguins eat. The information board says afternoon, but about what time is it?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask when the penguin feeding starts. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は十三時の予定です。変更があれば展示前の掲示に出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's scheduled for one p.m. today. Any changes will be posted in front of the exhibit.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今は十二時半ですね。先に近くで座れる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在時刻を踏まえ待つベンチを探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's twelve thirty now, right? Is there somewhere nearby to sit first?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Look for a bench to wait on, considering the current time. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ペンギン舎の手前にベンチがあります。そこから入口が見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: There are benches before the penguin house. You can see the entrance from there.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そこで待ちます。食事を見る場所は普段の水槽の前ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 食事を見られる展示側を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll wait there. Is the feeding viewed from the usual aquarium side?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check which side of the exhibit the feeding can be seen from. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日は外のプール側です。水槽側からは見えにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: Today it's on the outdoor pool side. It's hard to see from the aquarium side.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 外のプール側へ移ります。日陰で見られるところもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 屋外の観覧場所と日陰を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll move to the outdoor pool side. Is there a place to watch in the shade too?
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about outdoor viewing locations and shade. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 左の屋根の下から見えます。通路をふさがない位置でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can see it from under the roof on the left. Please choose a position that doesn't block the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 左の屋根を目印にします。まずベンチで休んで、時間前に掲示を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩と掲示確認を含む見学予定を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll use the roof on the left as my landmark. I'll rest on the bench first and check the posted notice before the time.
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain your viewing plan, including resting and checking the posted notice. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-028-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお楽しみください。失礼します。
